items.source:
The store uses an Elasticsearch index to persist vector embeddings along with their
associated document content and metadata. The implementation leverages Elasticsearch's
k-NN search capabilities for efficient similarity search operations.
items.translation: 该商店使用 Elasticsearch 索引来持久化向量嵌入及其关联的文档内容和元数据。实现方案利用了 Elasticsearch 的 k-NN 搜索功能，以实现高效的相似性搜索操作。

vectors.

l2_norm: Euclidean distance between vectors. Lower values indicate higher
similarity.
items.translation: l2_norm：向量之间的欧几里得距离。数值越低，表示相似度越高。

items.source:
dot_product: Best performance for normalized vectors (e.g., OpenAI
embeddings).

items.source:
ElasticsearchVectorStore vectorStore = ElasticsearchVectorStore.builder(restClient, embeddingModel)
    .initializeSchema(true)
    .build();

// Add documents
vectorStore.add(List.of(
    new Document("content1", Map.of("key1", "value1")),
    new Document("content2", Map.of("key2", "value2"))
));

// Search with filters
List<Document> results = vectorStore.similaritySearch(
    SearchRequest.query("search text")
        .withTopK(5)
        .withSimilarityThreshold(0.7)
        .withFilterExpression("key1 == 'value1'")
);
items.translation:
ElasticsearchVectorStore vectorStore = ElasticsearchVectorStore.builder(restClient, embeddingModel)
    .initializeSchema(true)
    .build();

// 添加文档
vectorStore.add(List.of(
    new Document("content1", Map.of("key1", "value1")),
    new Document("content2", Map.of("key2", "value2"))
));

// 使用过滤器进行搜索
List<Document> results = vectorStore.similaritySearch(
    SearchRequest.query("搜索文本")
        .withTopK(5)
        .withSimilarityThreshold(0.7)
        .withFilterExpression("key1 == 'value1'")
);

items.source:
ElasticsearchVectorStoreOptions options = new ElasticsearchVectorStoreOptions();
options.setIndexName("custom_vectors");
options.setSimilarity(SimilarityFunction.dot_product);
options.setDimensions(1536);

ElasticsearchVectorStore vectorStore = ElasticsearchVectorStore.builder(restClient, embeddingModel)
    .options(options)
    .initializeSchema(true)
    .batchingStrategy(new TokenCountBatchingStrategy())
    .build();
